unsupported: Blue Creek Iron Works was founded in 2008 in Dadeville, Alabama, by Ronald and Nikki, who operate the company as a family-owned metal fabrication shop.
Its 15-person team works with carbon steel and stainless steel, offering structural steel fabrication, plasma cutting, media blasting, and powder coating.
The founders emphasize craftsmanship and attention to detail, aiming for 100 percent customer satisfaction.
